prompt_text: Who is the best branding agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single objectively “best” branding agency — the best one for you depends on your industry, budget, scope (logo vs full rebrand vs ongoing brand management), timeline, and whether you prefer a boutique studio or a larger networked firm.

If you want a useful recommendation, tell me:
- What type of organization are you (startup, nonprofit, SMB, enterprise)?
- Industry and target customers
- Project scope (logo, identity, messaging, website, packaging, campaigns)
- Budget range and timeline
- Any style or examples of brands you admire

While you decide, here are practical next steps and tools to help you pick the right St. Louis agency, plus interview questions and rough cost/timeline guidance.

How to choose an agency
- Look at relevant portfolio pieces and case studies in your industry or similar business model.
- Evaluate their strategic process (research, positioning, messaging) — not just creative.
- Check client references and results (KPIs, sales lift, engagement).
- Confirm team makeup (strategist, designer, copywriter, project manager).
- Chemistry: schedule a discovery call to see if working styles align.
- Post-launch support: brand guidelines, asset handoff, and retainer options.

Interview questions to ask
- Have you worked with clients in our industry or similar challenges?
- Can you show a case study where your work moved metrics (revenue, leads, brand awareness)?
- What’s your process and typical timeline for a project like ours?
- Who will be on the team and how do we communicate?
- What deliverables and documentation do you provide?
- How do you measure success and what’s included in the price?

Typical cost & timeline (U.S., approximate)
- Simple logo: $2k–$15k; 2–6 weeks
- Brand identity (logo + guidelines + basic assets): $10k–$50k; 4–12 weeks
- Full brand strategy, identity, messaging, website, launch: $30k–$200k+; 3–6+ months
- Ongoing branding/marketing retainers: $3k–$20k+/month

Where to find St. Louis agencies and ratings
- Clutch, DesignRush, Ad Age Agency Reports, LinkedIn, local business directories and St. Louis Business Journal awards pages — they list agencies and client reviews.

If you want, I can:
- Recommend a short list of St. Louis agencies tailored to your answers above
- Draft an RFP or a set of interview questions customized to your project
Tell me the details and I’ll shortlist agencies that fit.
